comment: Single authority for the scalar text and boolean field tables shared by the descriptor stream, the render cache, and the browser command encoder. Edit this file, then run `python3 scripts/generate_protocol.py` to regenerate src/signals/native_protocol_gen.zig. Every field carries the browser opcode that sets it.

text_fields.name: class
text_fields.doc: CSS class list for browser presentation.

bool_fields.name: disabled
bool_fields.doc: Disables input while keeping the element and its identity.
